units: Bets. 15ᵇ בשעת פְּטִירָתָן when he dismissed them.—Esp. departure from the world, death.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:3">Y. Keth. XII, beg. 34ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:3">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>שלשה … בשעת פְּטִירָתוֹ וכ׳</he> Rabbi ordained three things when he departed this world.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:10">Deut. R. s. 11</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Micah 7:8">Mic. VII, 8</cite>) <he>כי נפלתי מפטירתו של משה וכ׳</he> though I fell when Moses died, I arose again under Joshua’s administration.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 6">Ab. VI</cite> <he>בשעת פטירתו של אדם וכ׳</he> when man leaves this world, neither silver nor gold nor jewels escort him &c.; a. fr.
